character: Traditional stone and wood village at the end of the Bon Nant valley below Mont Blanc. 42km ski domain linked to La Gorge and Megève area. Notre Dame de la Gorge baroque church (18th C). Quiet, authentic, family-friendly.
dining: Local Savoyard restaurants, pizzeria, mountain dining.
apres_scene: Quiet village apres. Local bar. Music at Refuge de la Frasse.
activities_nearby: 42km ski area, linked to St-Gervais/Megève. Notre Dame de la Gorge church. Truite pêche (trout fishing). Hiking in the Bon Nant valley. Mont Truc summit.
